_comment: WS3 fair cross-geometry comparison. Same per-node mass for every geometry AND nearest node at the same S (geometry_kwargs.normalize_nearest=true), per the near-field-dominance argument (tidal stretch ~1/d^3, so far nodes barely matter; equal-TOTAL-mass would wrongly weaken the near nodes). Isotropic (amp=0) so the comparison isolates the geometry's effect on the fit. Expectation: bars are close (near-field dominated); the near-neighbour multiplicity (cube26:6, fcc:12, bcc:8 nodes at S) is the only real difference.
